provenance.attribution: J. Sturm, N. Engelhard, F. Endres, W. Burgard, D. Cremers. A Benchmark for the Evaluation of RGB-D SLAM Systems. IROS 2012.
provenance.frame: optical center of RGB camera in fixed motion-capture world frame; each world coordinate is analyzed independently
provenance.conditions: Handheld Kinect facing an office desk; translations along camera principal axes with orientation mostly fixed; world-axis acceleration and applied forces were not controlled or provided.
provenance.measurement: External MotionAnalysis motion-capture system, nominal 100 Hz; this is not Kinect depth accuracy.

uncertainty.note: IROS 2012 section VI.C empirical bounds; not a calibrated probability distribution for every pose. Do not equate relative one-frame error with multi-second absolute prediction uncertainty.

provenance.transformation: Raw numeric text unchanged; evaluation makes timestamp-relative slices, decimates by timestamp, separates world x/y/z; no image or human identity data used.
provenance.physical_interpretation_approved: Observed camera position-time data suitable for bounded kinematic falsification; does not measure force, mass, or unknown physical law.

limitations: One public trajectory; axes and windows are correlated, not independent replications.
Forces and time-varying acceleration are unobserved; constant acceleration is a supplied local approximation.
Published error bounds are empirical setup summaries; per-pose covariance and timestamp uncertainty are unavailable.
Sensitivity budgets cover bounded position perturbations conditionally, not all model or timing errors.
A numerical control generated from the fit is not an independent physical observation.
Larger problems and open scientific novelty require additional independent evidence.

interpretation: software and bounded-model pilot evidence; independent human/scientific external validation remains pending
